source_relationship: AnimateCone is an algorithmic ancestor; this is an adapted N64 source, not recovered original declarations.
arcade_evidence: targets.c lines 1540–1571: signed-short index, target pointer, real 0.15 acceleration local, position scratch and two-stage gravity integration.
targets.h lines 126–145: target position, basis, linear and angular-velocity fields.
native_adaptations: Separate angular/linear motion allocation at object offset 108.
Object basis at 20, position at 56; descriptor stride 48 and unsigned flags at 18.
N64 frame time scalar and timer-driven release instead of arcade object-definition reset.
The descriptor pointer is substantively dereferenced; its original declaration is not established.
